title: Show an empty claims list with a way to start a claim
body:
### Summary

As a new claimant, I want to see that I have no claims yet and how to start one, so that I know what to do first.

### Completion Goal

1. [screenshot] state: `/claims` signed in as a seeded claimant with no claims; expected: the message "You have no claims yet" and a "Start a claim" button
2. [api-trace] state: GET /api/claims for a seeded claimant with no claims; expected: 200 with an empty list

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

all 2 criteria

### Scenario

Sign in as the seeded claimant with no claims, open the claims list, then call GET /api/claims as that claimant.

### Environment

local app with the seeded synthetic claimant; never production
